capabilities: show a paper's Zotero annotations, notes and metadata in a sidebar from zotero:// links
search the Zotero library and insert item links at the cursor
create literature notes and sync them with Zotero notes in both directions
drag sidebar annotations into notes as quotes with links back to the PDF
repair links to Zotero items that were merged or deleted
extras: Only personal Zotero libraries are supported (group libraries use a different API path). The plugin talks only to Zotero's local API on the same computer and sends nothing to remote servers; on mobile it falls back to offline annotation copies stored in literature notes.
intentEvidence: Migrate… makes it a note of this plugin: zotero-key becomes zotero-item
problem: Obsidian notes can link to Zotero papers, but reading their annotations means switching to Zotero, and keeping literature notes in sync with Zotero notes is manual.

relations.evidence: Zotero 7+ running locally (Zotero 10+ to send literature note edits back to Zotero)
Zotero has no built-in command to copy them, but the Actions & Tags add-on can
Migrate… makes it a note of this plugin: zotero-key becomes zotero-item, ZotLit's generated section

requires.name: Zotero 7+ (10+ for sending edits back), with its local API enabled

summary: Sidebar that shows Zotero PDF annotations for the paper under the cursor and keeps literature notes in sync with Zotero in both directions.
